cards.text: Jesus has seen the crowds harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd, and He's given His twelve disciples authority to drive out unclean spirits and heal every disease (Matthew 9:36; 10:1). Now He's sending those twelve out with instructions. No map, no group chat, just Jesus telling them exactly how this trip works.

cards.question: Jesus tells the twelve not to take the road of the Gentiles or enter any Samaritan town. Who does He send them to instead?

cards.text: And as they go, Jesus gives them one message to preach: "The kingdom of heaven is near."

cards.question: Jesus gave the twelve authority over every disease (Matthew 10:1). So He tells them to heal the sick and cleanse the ___.

cards.text: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. MY to-do list says check the oven, and THEIRS says raise the dead.
Then Jesus says, "Freely you have received; freely give."

cards.question: Jesus tells the twelve to give freely. Then He gets to packing. What does He say not to carry in their belts?
True or false: Jesus lets the twelve pack a second tunic for the road.

cards.text: No second tunic, no bag, no sandals, no staff. I live on a planet built for ONE bakery, and I still pack three aprons to walk to the oven.

cards.question: No money, no bag, no spare tunic. Why does Jesus say the twelve can travel this light?

answers.text: A worker deserves to be provided for
The towns are close to each other
The trip will only take a day

cards.text: So where do they sleep? Jesus says in whatever town or village they enter, find out who is worthy there.

cards.question: Once they find that worthy person, Jesus tells the twelve to ___ at his house until they move on.

cards.text: As they walk in, Jesus tells them to greet the people who live there. If the home is worthy, He says to let their peace rest on it.

cards.question: True or false: if the home isn't worthy, Jesus says the twelve's peace still rests on it.

cards.text: If the home isn't worthy, Jesus says to let their peace return to them. But what if a home or town won't welcome them or listen to their words at all?

cards.question: True or false: Jesus tells the twelve to leave a home or town that won't welcome them.

cards.text: When they leave, Jesus says to shake the dust off their feet. I spent YEARS under dust in a junk drawer, and NOBODY told me I could just shake it off.

cards.question: On the day of judgment, Jesus says two cities will have it more bearable than a town that won't welcome the twelve. Which two?

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the twelve He's sending them out like sheep among wolves. That's a cookie walking into the break room at three in the afternoon.

cards.question: Jesus is sending the twelve out like sheep among wolves. So what does He tell them to be?

cards.text: As shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves. Minty, one of my cookie cutter kids, is shaped like a dove, so this papa just stood a little taller on his gold base.
But Jesus warns them to beware of men. He says they'll hand the twelve over to their councils and flog them in their synagogues.

cards.question: And it doesn't stop at the local councils. Who does Jesus say the twelve will be brought before?
True or false: Jesus says the twelve will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.

cards.text: When they're handed over, Jesus says don't worry about how to respond or what to say. Friend, I rehearse what I'm gonna say to the OVEN, and the oven doesn't even talk back.

cards.question: No speech prepared. What does Jesus promise the twelve for that hour?

answers.text: They will be given what to say
A friend will speak for them

cards.text: Jesus says it won't be them speaking, but the Spirit of their Father speaking through them.
Then it gets heavy. Jesus says brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child, and children will rise against their parents.

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the twelve will be hated by everyone because of His name.
Hated by everyone because of His name. But Jesus says the one who ___ to the end will be saved.
True or false: when one town persecutes them, Jesus tells the twelve to stay and stand their ground there.

cards.text: Jesus says to flee to the next town, and then: "Truly I tell you, you will not reach all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes." Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10).

cards.question: Jesus says a disciple is not above his ___, nor a servant above his master.

cards.text: Jesus says it's enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. And if the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, a name for the prince of the demons (Matthew 12:24)…

cards.question: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, what does Jesus say about the members of his household?

answers.text: They can expect it even more

cards.text: And we'll pause right there, friend. Grab a fresh apron, because Jesus isn't done talking and this teaching keeps going.
